story: Bought a mixer grinder for ₹4,299 from ShopKart on 28 October. It arrived on time but the motor started smoking the very first time I used it. I raised a return request in the ShopKart app on 1 November with photos and a video. On 6 November they rejected it, saying 'physical damage by customer'. I did nothing wrong! Now I'm stuck with a burnt mixer and no refund.
